title: Roll Volley Lift (Michelle Grogan)
style: funk-rnb-reggaeton-cumbia-dnb fusion 134bpm slap bass Rhodes sax horns dembow marimba guiro congas dnb chorus beatbox claps English Spanish coach calls
lyrics:
[Intro]
Roll volley lift roll volley lift
Wrist roll smooth a precious gift
Roll volley lift roll volley lift
Low ball at the kitchen drift

[Verse 1]
When the ball is below the net at the line
Roll volley lift is the design
Wrist rolls forward paddle face up
Lifts the ball over with a topspin cup
Vamos vamos rueda suave
Roll volley lift the kinetic wave
Forearm rolls forward through the ball
Clears the net never stalls

[Pre-Chorus]
Roll lift roll lift
Wrist forward in a drift
Roll lift roll lift
Low to high the gift

[Chorus]
Roll volley lift below the net height
Roll volley lift makes it right
Roll volley lift wrist rolling smooth
Roll volley lift finds the groove
Vamos vamos pa lante
Roll volley
Vamos vamos pa lante
Low ball ahoy

[Verse 2]
Forehand roll volley wrist rolls in to out
Backhand roll volley wrist rolls without a doubt
Same principle low ball at the net
Lift it up gently never let
Uno dos tres roll forward
Wrist motion always toward
Dont go for power just clear and over
Roll volley lift like a four leaf clover

[Bridge]
Common error trying to drive when low
Thats how the ball goes into the net low
When below net height roll and lift
Thats the rule the smart shift

[Chorus]
Roll volley lift below the net height
Roll volley lift makes it right
Roll volley lift wrist rolling smooth
Roll volley lift finds the groove

[Outro]
Roll volley lift roll volley lift
Wrist roll smooth a precious gift
Roll volley lift roll volley lift
Low ball at the kitchen drift
